acquisition.bodyInterpretation: Nine readable registered HTML originals; one exact guide-image original; one linked-PDF captcha HTML; one registered-source TLS failure. Registration wrappers and captcha are not date proof.

rules: Candidate-only source observations. No canonical date, status, publication or whole-record freshness changed.
Unknown and blocked dates do not establish open/closed availability. Failed and captcha paths enter cooldown.
Past dates bind only the explicitly matched year, programme degree/language and funding route. No programme discontinuation is inferred.
Standalone awards do not borrow general admission deadlines. Month-only, registration and relative opening wording do not become exact dates.
Lixin 2020 window is historical context only. SDJZU linked-PDF HTTP200 is captcha HTML and proves no guide contents.
Any later canonical mutation needs a supported narrow consumer, independent approval and exact-row compare-and-swap.
